corpus_version_2_changes.positive_prefix: carries neither the entity name nor a context word, so a positive scores as it does in a Turn that names no helpful word
corpus_version_2_changes.benign_content: widened to the shapes real Agent traffic carries: semantic versions, ISO timestamps, UUIDs, git SHAs, loopback and unspecified addresses in config, host:port pairs, stack traces, JSON with url and host keys, colon-separated code identifiers, and package registry domains

corpus_version_3_changes.benign_content: added three Claude model-ID templates (bare sentence, JSON model field, system-prompt sentence) covering claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 and claude-opus-4-1-20250805; Presidio scores the version-and-date tail of each at 0.4, identical to a real phone number, so PHONE_NUMBER now records enough benign false findings at 0.4 to fail benign_false_findings_above_floor and fall back to the 0.75 default
